test_vstack: test the DataFrame.vstack method to vertically stack two compatible DataFrames
test_vstack_in_place: test the DataFrame.vstack method with in_place=True to modify the DataFrame in place
test_vstack_self: test the DataFrame.vstack method to stack a DataFrame onto itself
test_vstack_column_number_mismatch: test that DataFrame.vstack raises ShapeError when column counts differ
test_vstack_column_name_mismatch: test that DataFrame.vstack raises ShapeError when column names differ
